prompt: Edit this existing three-state concept sheet of the SAME sneezing cardboard box for a cooperative slapstick game. Keep the same three-panel layout, cardboard materials, paper tape, blank side label, neutral studio background, camera angle, lighting, and no arms or legs. Add a moderate dose of absurd deadpan slapstick humor rather than polished mascot cuteness. LEFT IDLE: slightly uneven, half-lidded eyes with tiny unfocused pupils, one brow raised and the other low, a tiny crooked open mouth showing a single blunt square cardboard-colored tooth: a lovable vacant 'nothing going on in there' expression. MIDDLE INHALE: comically fighting a sneeze, eyes almost crossed and squeezed upward, nostrils scrunched, lips tightly puckered off-center, one cheek much more inflated than the other, body subtly lopsided from pressure. RIGHT RELEASE: wildly off-center gaping mouth, squeezed shut eyes at different angles, cheeks rippling in chunky simple shapes, the same single little tooth visible, box briefly squashed by recoil and tape slightly lifted at its end, with a compact pale blue air puff shooting forward from the mouth. Humor comes from expression and squash/stretch of the box itself. Keep the character recognizable and geometry simple enough to interpret as a stylized game asset. No mucus, drool, vomit, body fluids, gross-out, realistic human skin, extra characters, limbs, new props, captions or words. Maintain material and identity consistency across all states, slight scuff marks are okay. Make it funny at thumbnail size. All boxes and the complete air puff must fit comfortably within the canvas with generous margins. This is a game art concept reference, not gameplay.
